# hermes_model_options (Data Source)

Reads the profile-scoped, non-secret model inventory from Hermes. Use `refresh` sparingly because Hermes may contact provider catalogs when refreshing.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `explicit_only` (Boolean) Whether to return only explicitly configured providers.
- `include_unconfigured` (Boolean) Whether to include providers without configured credentials.
- `profile` (String) Optional Hermes profile to scope model discovery. An omitted value uses Hermes' active/default profile.
- `refresh` (Boolean) Whether Hermes should refresh provider model catalogs instead of using its cache. This can perform network requests to provider endpoints.

### Read-Only

- `current_model` (String)
- `current_provider` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `providers` (Attributes List) Available Hermes provider rows and their model identifiers. Credentials and tokens are not returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `auth_type` (String)
- `authenticated` (Boolean)
- `is_current` (Boolean)
- `is_user_defined` (Boolean)
- `key_env` (String)
- `models` (List of String)
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)
- `source` (String)
- `total_models` (Number)
- `warning` (String)
